cohort: The study included data from 407 births in a single UK centre between 2016 and 2017, where fetal scalp blood sampling was performed less than 60 minutes before birth.
finding: Fetal scalp blood sampling (FSBS) pH < 7.20 demonstrated low sensitivity (28.6% for neonatal acidaemia, 38.1% for low Apgar scores) but high specificity (85.5% for neonatal acidaemia, 90.82% for low Apgar scores) for predicting adverse neonatal outcomes.
